boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission art, history, and self-guided outings for University of San Diego students and visitors.

cards.title: Browse prints at Hoehn Family Galleries
cards.subtitle: Founders Hall, University of San Diego
cards.notes: Walk through the print and graphic-arts displays in Founders Hall, then use the exhibition brochures or ask a Gallery Guide about a work on view.
cards.short_summary: A free campus gallery stop centered on prints and graphic arts.
cards.evidence_claim: USD states that University Galleries exhibitions and programs are free to the public unless otherwise noted, and lists the Hoehn Family Galleries in Founders Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open only during posted gallery hours; campus weekday parking may require payment, but no ticket or purchase is required for the gallery.

cards.title: See art at the KIPJ Fine Art Galleries
cards.subtitle: Joan B. Kroc Institute for Peace and Justice, University of San Diego
cards.notes: Check the current KIPJ display before heading over, and pair the visit with a walk through the institute’s public-facing gallery area.
cards.short_summary: A free USD exhibition space inside the Kroc Institute for Peace and Justice.
cards.evidence_claim: USD lists KIPJ Fine Art Galleries at the Kroc Institute for Peace and Justice and says University Galleries exhibitions and programs are free to the public unless otherwise noted.
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery page for current display availability; tickets and reservations are not required unless USD notes an exception.

cards.title: Visit the David W. May Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saints Tekakwitha and Serra Hall, University of San Diego
cards.notes: Make this a focused art break: view the exhibition in Serra Hall, use the provided interpretive materials, and continue to the nearby Humanities Center Gallery.
cards.short_summary: A free University Galleries stop in Saints Tekakwitha and Serra Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USD lists the David W. May Gallery in Saints Tekakwitha and Serra Hall and says University Galleries exhibitions and programs are free to the public unless otherwise noted.
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted public hours; no gallery ticket or reservation is required unless otherwise noted.

cards.title: Take in the Humanities Center Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saints Tekakwitha and Serra Hall, University of San Diego
cards.notes: Stop by the Humanities Center Gallery for the current installation, then use the exhibition information to choose one piece for a closer group discussion.
cards.short_summary: A free campus gallery for rotating art and humanities-focused displays.
cards.evidence_claim: USD lists the Humanities Center Gallery in Saints Tekakwitha and Serra Hall and says University Galleries exhibitions and programs are free to the public unless otherwise noted.
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted public hours; galleries close for university holidays and may not open outside public hours.

cards.title: Look closely at ICA San Diego Central
cards.subtitle: 1439 El Prado, Balboa Park
cards.notes: Use the gallery’s visual-thinking prompts to compare reactions with friends, then take a short walk through Balboa Park’s public outdoor spaces.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art in Balboa Park with complimentary admission.
cards.evidence_claim: ICA San Diego states that admission is always complimentary at both locations and identifies its Central location at 1439 El Prado in Balboa Park.
cards.access_notes: Check the ICA site for current open status before going; admission is always free and donations are optional.

cards.title: Spend time with the Timken collection
cards.subtitle: 1500 El Prado, Balboa Park
cards.notes: Pick a small number of paintings or icons to discuss rather than rushing the collection, then step outside to continue exploring Balboa Park.
cards.short_summary: An always-free Balboa Park museum of European, American, and Russian icon art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Timken Museum states that it is always free and provides free guided tours; it is located at 1500 El Prado in Balboa Park.
cards.access_notes: The museum posts its current hours online; admission is free, while transportation or parking can carry separate costs.

cards.title: Follow the Stuart Collection on foot
cards.subtitle: UC San Diego campus, La Jolla
cards.notes: Choose several outdoor works from the map, walk between them at your own pace, and use the digital guide to compare what each artist made for its site.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided contemporary-art walk across UC San Diego.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stuart Collection invites visitors to take a free, self-guided tour of more than 20 sculptures across the UC San Diego campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculptures are distributed across campus; follow the collection map and respect any posted building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Explore textile art at Visions
cards.subtitle: 2825 Dewey Road, Liberty Station
cards.notes: Start with the current exhibition, identify a material or technique you want to learn more about, and browse the artist-talk listings before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A free Liberty Station museum devoted to contemporary textile art.
cards.evidence_claim: Visions Museum of Textile Art states that admission is free and lists its location at 2825 Dewey Road in San Diego.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery hours before travel; museum admission is free, with any optional purchases separate.

cards.entity_name: May S. Marcy Sculpture Court and Garden
cards.title: Meet at the May S. Marcy Sculpture Court
cards.subtitle: San Diego Museum of Art, 1450 El Prado, Balboa Park
cards.notes: Use the free outdoor sculpture court and garden as a low-key meetup, then choose a sculpture to sketch, photograph, or discuss together.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor sculpture-and-garden space at the San Diego Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: The San Diego Museum of Art states that entry to the May S. Marcy Sculpture Court and Garden is free.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission - San Diego Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The sculpture court’s hours vary when private events occur; outdoor entry is free, while museum gallery admission has separate rules.

cards.title: Learn from the Barona Cultural Center & Museum
cards.subtitle: 1095 Barona Road, Lakeside
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit to view Kumeyaay cultural materials, then use the museum’s Native Plant Garden guide to extend the conversation outdoors.
cards.short_summary: A free museum presenting local Kumeyaay culture and history.
cards.evidence_claim: Barona Cultural Center & Museum states that admission is free and lists public hours Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Check current public hours and call ahead for group tours or research appointments; admission does not require a purchase.
